message: Refined generated single broad goal into 8 grouped tranche goals. Each workspace crate is assigned to exactly one audit tranche and must receive an individual readiness artifact plus aggregate matrix coverage.

evidence: Created docs/quality/crate-readiness README, matrix, dependency-topology, and 83 per-package worksheets from cargo metadata; coverage check packages=83 matrix_rows=83 docs=86; rg trailing whitespace found no matches; cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo check --workspace, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test --workspace, cargo run -p xtask -- clean-room-audit, and git diff --check passed with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 RUSTFLAGS=-C debuginfo=0.

evidence: Audited and hardened G002 crates tdw-core, tdw-domain, tdw-protocol, tdw-config, tdw-event, tdw-actor, tdw-bus, tdw-cdc, tdw-outbox, tdw-snapshot, tdw-replay, tdw-rollout, and tdw-session. Updated 13 readiness worksheets and matrix verdicts to Ready with follow-ups.
